svg.text: ( JUST-IN-TIME PROJECT MANAGEMENT · the capstone that fixes overwhelm )
BUSY IS NOT FINISHED — LET THE DEADLINE CLOSE THE SWITCH.
Neural Signal Schematic · capped active bay vs dark dormant field
parked / done — calm, not an alarm
almost every project — switch OPEN, drawing ZERO current
PARKED · INVENTORY WAITING FOR DEMAND · COSTS YOU NOTHING
reviewed weekly: 'does anything need to activate yet?' — usually no. that's fine.
WEEKLY REVIEW · scan the parked field, pull nothing on guilt
THE STACK ASSEMBLES EACH PROJECT FOR YOU — it lands PRE-LOADED, never blank
gathers resources + maps · drafts the plan & the first next action
lights ONLY because the 3.0 / 4.0 / 4.1 feeds are live — fundamental before multiplier
headroom to the limiter — then pull the next.
PROJECTS & LEARNING — TWO FACES OF ONE PULL
project pulls for, on the job
let real demand pull the work AND the learning — never stockpile either
all switches closed → supply spread thin
every load BROWNS OUT below useful work
A FEW ON, REST PARKED · just-in-time
only 3–5 closed → the active few run
so cap the bay and let demand choose.
a fully-repeatable project type hands off to
an AUTONOMOUS RUNNER that executes it.
— the lower layers are why the kit assembles itself.
CAP 3–5 · PARKED = GUILT-FREE · DEADLINES PULL, NOT ANXIETY · FINISH BEFORE YOU START · COMPLETION > OPEN
